kpis.label: Reference price
kpis.sub: Upper band Rs 1,665 (NSE issue page). At Rs 1,665: market cap Rs 10,702.7 cr (Rs 10,815.1 cr fully diluted); P/E 41.3x FY26 diluted EPS (40.8x on diluted shares, 33.5x on annualised Q1 FY27); P/B 9.3x Jun-26 diluted book. Pure OFS: no new money for the company.

focus.title: Cash flow vs profit
focus.detail: Operating cash flow Rs -13.27 / -120.17 / +235.24 cr FY24-26 against PAT Rs 175.16 / 229.78 / 265.20 cr (cumulative 15%). Carry ('Variable Additional Return') is booked at fair value before it is received: unrealised carry Rs 94.57 / 190.73 / 290.47 cr was recognised, while realised carry of Rs 430.69 cr (FY26) and Rs 338.10 cr (Q1 FY27) came in as cash. FY26-Q1 FY27 operating cash flow Rs 365.6 cr against PAT Rs 345.9 cr.

focus.title: Current vs deferred tax
focus.detail: Current tax only Rs 3.94 cr on FY26 PBT Rs 338.64 cr, deferred tax Rs 69.50 cr: tax on unrealised carry and fair-value gains is deferred until realisation (deferred tax liability Rs 145.06 cr at Jun-26). In Q1 FY27, as carry was realised, current tax was Rs 56.41 cr with a Rs 31.31 cr deferred-tax reversal. Tax follows cash, as expected.

focus.title: Related-party capex & subsidiaries
focus.detail: Part of the Edelweiss group: in FY25 it bought asset-management rights (Rs 21.32 cr), sponsor units and carry rights from group companies; group term loans have been repaid; a dividend of Rs 205.70 cr (78% of FY26 PAT) was paid to the group in FY26 before the IPO. Executive Chairman Rashesh Shah also chairs EFSL.

focus.title: Revaluation reserve
focus.detail: Distribution costs of raising funds are capitalised and amortised over fund tenure; unamortised balance Rs 667.94 cr at Jun-26 (58% of net worth), up Rs 167.03 cr in FY26. Permitted by Ind AS and matched to fees, but reported profit is higher than on a pay-as-you-go basis while fund-raising grows (adjusted P/E in part 5).

issues.issuer: National Stock Exchange of India Ltd

strengths: One of India's larger alternatives platforms: AUM Rs 65,504 cr (Sep-25), fee-paying AUM Rs 48,623 cr (Jun-26) (DRHP p. 222; Add. p. 7)
Funds in third and fourth series; 73% of AUM from repeat clients (DRHP p. 222)
ROE 25.97% in FY26 with modest capex (Add. p. 7)
Management fees up 20-21% a year FY25-26 (Add. p. 7)
Asset operating platform (Sekura) for infrastructure portfolios (DRHP p. 222)
weaknesses: Carry is a third of revenue and lumpy; FY23 PAT (Rs 322.19 cr) was higher than FY25 (DRHP p. 19)
Capitalised distribution costs flatter reported profit while fund-raising grows (Add. p. 119)
Cost-to-income 63.8% (FY26), 68.5% in Q1 FY27, well above AMC peers (Add. p. 7)
MD & CEO resigned in Sep-2025; now led by two CEOs (DRHP p. 272)
Group linkages: brand, past rights purchases, dividend to promoter (DRHP pp. 22-24)
opportunities: Indian alternatives industry growth (issuer-paid CARE report, DRHP p. 158)
Infrastructure yield, InvIT and energy-transition funds (DRHP p. 223)
Global and GIFT City fund-raising (DRHP p. 223)
Realisation of accrued carry in maturing funds (Add. p. 108)
threats: Fund underperformance reducing carry and fund-raising (DRHP p. 20)
Valuation subjectivity in unlisted fund assets (DRHP p. 20)
Tax and regulatory changes for AIFs (DRHP p. 20)
Overhang: promoter group holds about 84% after the OFS

adjustments.item: Upfront selling and distribution costs of fund-raising capitalised as prepaid expenses (net increase in the year)
adjustments.reason: Upfront and trail fees paid to distributors for raising funds are amortised over each fund's tenure; the unamortised balance (prepaid expenses, current + non-current) rose from Rs 255.01 cr (FY23) to Rs 384.57 / 471.52 / 638.55 cr (FY24-26) and Rs 667.94 cr at Jun-26. Ind AS permits capitalising incremental costs of obtaining a contract and this matches the fee stream, but expensing them as paid would cut FY26 pre-tax profit by Rs 167.03 cr. Flag: timing, not a cash leak - the cost is real and is being recognised over time.

adjustments.item: One-off charge for the new Labour Codes (exceptional item)
adjustments.reason: Statutory impact of the new Labour Codes, Rs 9.88 cr, shown as an exceptional item in FY26; one-off, so added back.

adjustments.item: Tax credit for earlier years (grossed up to pre-tax)
adjustments.reason: Excess tax of earlier years written back: Rs 13.70 cr in FY24, Rs 0.53 cr in FY25, Rs 0.64 cr in FY26 (post-tax). Shown grossed up so the post-tax effect matches.

adjustments.item: Unrealised carry (Variable Additional Return booked at fair value)
adjustments.reason: Carry is recognised as the fund NAV crosses its hurdle, before it is paid; it is a normal accounting policy and was realised in cash at Rs 430.69 cr in FY26. Excluding it gives a fee-plus-investment-income view of the P/E. For information.

adjustments.item: GP income: interest and fair-value gains on the company's own fund investments
adjustments.reason: Returns on the company's sponsor and co-investment commitments, reported in other income. Recurring for an alternatives manager but market-linked. For information.

earnings_quality.verdict: Reported FY26 P/E of 40.8x is flattered by the items flagged: adjusted P/E 73.6x (PAT -44.6%). On the FY24-FY26 average, which smooths one-year items, the P/E is 48.4x reported and 86.4x adjusted.
